name: Homelite UT43122
blurb: Oregon lists UT43122 with three 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chains: 14″/52, 16″/56 and 18″/62 drive links.
intro: The Homelite UT43122 is in the same Oregon block as the UT10517. Oregon's saw-chain selection guide does not give this model its own line. It prints the model in one Homelite block with other model numbers, and under that block it prints three chains, all 3/8″ low profile at .050″ gauge: S52 on 14″ (52 drive links), S56 on 16″ (56 drive links) and S62 on 18″ (62 drive links). Oregon does not say which of the three lengths left the factory on this model number. The bar on the saw picks the count. The same block includes the UT10517 and the UT43122. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S52 under this Homelite block: 14″ bar, 52 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The block lists many model numbers. No file size is printed.
Oregon prints S56 under this Homelite block: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The block lists many model numbers. No file size is printed.
Oregon prints S62 under this Homelite block: 18″ bar, 62 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The block lists many model numbers. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
